scope: Primary-source survey of surgical appearance, geometry and internal anatomy. Broad but not exhaustive. Public access is not evidence of unrestricted training or redistribution.

datasets.name: HyperKvasir
datasets.potential_use: Mucosa, polyps, wet highlights, GI color variation; 110079 total images, 10662 labeled images, 1000 segmented images, 374 videos reported in paper.
datasets.limitations: No per-pixel albedo, roughness, thickness or scattering labels; internal luminal tissue cannot substitute for exterior serosa. Remove picture-in-picture overlays and split by procedure where available. See paper count/version differences.

datasets.name: HeiPorSPECTRAL
datasets.modality: HSI, reconstructed RGB, organ masks, metadata
datasets.potential_use: 20 organ/tissue classes across 11 animals; calibrated spectral distributions and per-organ reflectance priors.
datasets.limitations: 640x480 spatial resolution, 500-1000nm bands, no complete BRDF/BSSRDF. RGB reconstructed from spectral bands. Official site says 5756 cubes while article abstract says 5758. Full archive 844GiB; initial two-image sample is not statistically representative.

datasets.name: NLM Visible Human Project
datasets.potential_use: Internal cut-surface anatomy, fat-organ boundaries and cross-section registration.
datasets.limitations: Two cadavers; freezing, sectioning and lack of perfusion shift appearance. Not a living organ-surface or deformation benchmark.

datasets.name: Dresden Surgical Anatomy Dataset
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 metadata; article adds non-commercial wording
datasets.potential_use: 13195 images from 32 surgeries, 11 anatomical structures including vessels; masks suitable for organ patches and boundary analysis.
datasets.limitations: One clinical procedure/site cohort. Article usage note conflicts with CC BY metadata; commercial reuse remains unresolved. Original archive 20884637683 bytes, supplied MD5 18e3514b651c572c9e421fe26cf5adbc. Existing selected reference PNGs in Studio; no new copy automatically acquired.

datasets.name: CholecSeg8k
datasets.potential_use: 8080 frames, 13 classes; liver, gallbladder, connective tissue and blood visibility.
datasets.limitations: Small Cholec80 subset, adjacent frames strongly correlated. Noncommercial/share-alike restrictions; honor source-video split and dataset overlap.

datasets.name: Endoscapes2023
datasets.modality: Laparoscopic RGB, segmentations, detection and CVS annotations
datasets.potential_use: Dissection-region context, cystic plate/artery/duct and hepatocystic transition boundaries.
datasets.limitations: Public Seg50 is 493 segmented frames from 50 videos; broader segmentation release remains private. Cross-dataset overlap with Cholec80/T50 must be removed; research-only source tier.

datasets.name: HeiSurF
datasets.potential_use: Surgical tissue context and scene segmentation.
datasets.limitations: Synapse access conditions and underlying data license must be reviewed in an authorized account; no automated fetch or inferred permission.

datasets.name: SCARED
datasets.potential_use: Stereo/depth validation and geometry/appearance separation.
datasets.limitations: Measured keyframes and propagated estimates must remain distinct. Cadaver tissue, sparse geometric measurements, restricted access; no third-party mirrors used.

datasets.name: StereoMIS
datasets.modality: Stereo videos, kinematics, automatic tool masks
datasets.potential_use: Three animals, 11 surgical sequences for motion, lighting and tool occlusion tests.
datasets.limitations: 11.2GB compressed; masks are automatic and kinematics are not perfect deformation ground truth. Porcine-to-human domain shift; no automatic production training.

datasets.name: EndoNeRF sample data
datasets.modality: RGB, estimated stereo depth, manual tool masks, LLFF format
datasets.potential_use: Two sample cases for dynamic view synthesis, cutting and pulling tissue.
datasets.limitations: Authors evaluate photometric errors due to geometric ground-truth collection difficulty. Identity camera poses used in single-view setting. Code license must not be substituted for data rights; secondary NC-SA claims unverified in inspected primary README.

datasets.name: Hamlyn Laparoscopic/Endoscopic Video Datasets
datasets.potential_use: Tissue motion, specularities, breathing, occlusion and stereo baseline testing.
datasets.limitations: Official page fetch timed out during review; retain per-sequence species, calibration and rights rather than treating collection as homogeneous.

datasets.name: SurgT
datasets.modality: Stereo videos and soft-tissue tracking annotations
datasets.potential_use: Temporal tissue consistency benchmark.
datasets.limitations: Challenge rules prohibit annotated surgical training and reserve validation ground truth for evaluation. Benchmark rules are not a general dataset license. Official data page returned 403; no bypass.

datasets.name: SERV-CT
datasets.modality: Stereo endoscopy with CT-derived reference disparity
datasets.potential_use: Geometry/depth checks around texture-poor tissue and specular surfaces.
datasets.limitations: Two ex-vivo porcine torsos in source paper. CT registration and reference uncertainty matter; cannot prove living tissue appearance.

datasets.name: C3VD / C3VDv2
datasets.modality: Clinical colonoscope RGB with registered geometry
datasets.potential_use: Depth, normals, flow, camera pose and surface coverage benchmarks with known models.
datasets.limitations: Phantom material is not human mucosa. V2 deformation sequences are explicitly simplified and lack realistic insufflation/peristalsis.

datasets.name: Kvasir-Instrument
datasets.modality: GI RGB images, instrument masks and boxes
datasets.license: research/education only; commercial written permission required
datasets.potential_use: 590 images for excluding instrument contamination from tissue appearance statistics.
datasets.limitations: 720x576 to 1280x1024, JPEG; masks label instruments, not complete anatomy. Restrictions distinct from HyperKvasir.

datasets.name: Kvasir-SEG
datasets.potential_use: Polyp and mucosal boundary reference.
datasets.limitations: Overlaps HyperKvasir segmented record; do not count as independent evaluation cohort or duplicate data.

datasets.name: Dresden 4D (D4D)
datasets.modality: Stereo videos, structured-light point clouds and derived depth
datasets.potential_use: Non-rigid abdominal scene reconstruction, tool interactions and temporal geometry validation.
datasets.limitations: Six sessions, 98 curated recordings, >300000 frames, 369 measured point clouds reported by authors. Distinguish measured geometry from stereo-derived estimates; no human material ground truth.

datasets.name: STIR
datasets.potential_use: Visible tissue tracking with infrared tattoos as hidden reference.
datasets.limitations: Tracking reference does not measure optical material parameters; challenge versions and source subjects must remain distinct.

datasets.name: EndoVis / Open-CAS index
datasets.potential_use: Discovery of robotic segmentation, kidney, fetoscopy, cataract, tool, colonoscopy and workflow datasets.
datasets.limitations: Index is not a single downloadable dataset. Each challenge has its own access/terms; registration may require signed rules.

datasets.name: PhaKIR
datasets.potential_use: Procedure and instrument context to filter tissue reference clips.
datasets.limitations: Tool/workflow annotations do not give intrinsic tissue appearance or physical properties.

datasets.name: iMED 2026
datasets.potential_use: Multi-view pose and novel-view evaluation.
datasets.limitations: Version-specific participation/data terms required. Metrics for rendering do not establish surgical fidelity.
